SELECT s.id, s.document_id, d.title AS document_title, d.file_type, s.title, s.content, s.original_content, s.order_index, s.category_id, c.name AS category_name, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name) FROM tag t INNER JOIN section_tag st ON t.id = st.tag_id WHERE st.section_id = s.id) AS tag_names, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(st2.tag_id) FROM section_tag st2 WHERE st2.section_id = s.id) AS tag_ids_str, s.update_time FROM document_section s LEFT JOIN document d ON s.document_id = d.id LEFT JOIN category c ON s.category_id = c.id
AND s.document_id = #{documentId} AND s.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM section_tag st3 WHERE st3.section_id = s.id AND st3.tag_id = #{tagId})
AND (s.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR s.content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY s.document_id, s.order_index

SELECT s.id, s.document_id, d.title AS document_title, d.file_type, s.title, s.content, s.original_content, s.order_index, s.category_id, c.name AS category_name, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name) FROM tag t INNER JOIN section_tag st ON t.id = st.tag_id WHERE st.section_id = s.id) AS tag_names, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(st2.tag_id) FROM section_tag st2 WHERE st2.section_id = s.id) AS tag_ids_str, s.update_time FROM document_section s LEFT JOIN document d ON s.document_id = d.id LEFT JOIN category c ON s.category_id = c.id WHERE s.id = #{sectionId}
